resources.string: This device could not be reached. On it, open KueTV → Settings → Data → Local sync and turn Sync mode on. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Colour of the KueTV icon and logo
You chose a new icon and logo. They take effect after KueTV restarts.
What KueTV shows when it starts: Home, the channel you watched last, your favourites, or a channel you pick.
Looks on GitHub for a newer KueTV now and offers to install it. Your playlists, favourites and settings stay as they are.
Stage draws KueTV’s own soft colours. Picture shows a picture of yours behind every screen. Plain is a flat dark fill.
The KueTV logo in the menu, About and setup shows its play triangle in your accent colour. The icon on the home screen keeps its own colours.
This address is for the KueTV app on your other device. Open Local sync there and pick this device from the list.
